steps.title: After king Thordan appears
steps.rule: Go to 4m north of the centre.

MainTank.rule: Go to 4m south of the centre.

steps.title: After ser Guerrique appears
steps.rule: Go to 2m south of the centre.

RegenHealer.rule: with WarriorBearing as north: 6m west of the centre.

ShieldHealer.rule: with WarriorBearing as north: 6m east of the centre.

MeleeDpsA.rule: with WarriorBearing as north: 4m south-west of the centre.

MeleeDpsB.rule: with WarriorBearing as north: 4m south-east of the centre.

steps.title: After doom on another player
steps.rule: Each role has its own spot.

MainTank.rule: with WarriorBearing as north: 2m south of the centre.

RegenHealer.rule: with WarriorBearing as north: 6m west of the centre.

ShieldHealer.rule: with WarriorBearing as north: 6m east of the centre.

MeleeDpsA.rule: with WarriorBearing as north: 4m south-west of the centre.

MeleeDpsB.rule: with WarriorBearing as north: 4m south-east of the centre.

PhysRangedDps.rule: with WarriorBearing as north: 3m south-west of the centre.

CasterDps.rule: with WarriorBearing as north: 3m south-east of the centre.

steps.title: After sprint on you
steps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: NonDoomOrder).

steps.title: After sprint on you
steps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: NonDoomOrder).

steps.title: After sprint on you
steps.rule: with WarriorBearing as north: 13m west of the centre.

ShieldHealer.rule: with WarriorBearing as north: 13m east of the centre.

MainTank.rule: Go to 13m south of the centre.

MeleeDpsB.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat.

OffTank.rule: Go to 13m south of the centre.

CasterDps.rule: Go to 13m north of the centre.

steps.title: After sprint on you
steps.rule: Each role has its own spot.

MainTank.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: Dooms has OffTank).

PhysRangedDps.rule: with WarriorBearing as north: the south-west wall.

OffTank.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: EyeBearing).

CasterDps.rule: with WarriorBearing as north: the south-east wall.

OffTank.rule: When Dooms includes OT and Puddles includes (12.4,14.9), go to 3m south-west of the centre; when Dooms leaves out OT and Puddles leaves out (12.4,14.9), go to 3m south-west of the centre; when Dooms includes OT and Puddles leaves out (12.4,14.9), go to 3m north-east of the centre.

RegenHealer.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: Puddles has (14.9,-12.5)).

ShieldHealer.rule: When Dooms includes R2 and Puddles leaves out (-0,20), stand at the centre; when Dooms includes R2 and Puddles includes (-0,20), go to 4m south of the centre; when Dooms leaves out R2 and Puddles includes (-0,20), stand at the centre.

MeleeDpsA.rule: When Dooms leaves out M1 and Dooms leaves out MT, stand at the centre; when Dooms includes M1 and Dooms leaves out MT, stand at the centre; when Dooms includes M1 and Dooms includes MT, go to 4m north of the centre; when Dooms leaves out M1 and Dooms includes MT, stand at the centre.

MeleeDpsB.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: NonDoomOrder).

CasterDps.rule: When Dooms includes H1 and Dooms includes OT, go to 3m south-east of the centre; when Dooms includes H1 and Dooms leaves out OT, go to 4m north of the centre; when Dooms leaves out H1 and Dooms leaves out OT, go to 3m south-east of the centre; when Dooms leaves out H1 and Dooms includes OT, go to 3m south-east of the centre.

steps.title: After sprint on you
steps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: NonDoomOrder).

MainTank.rule: When Dooms leaves out M1 and Puddles includes (12.4,14.9), go to 3m north-west of the centre; when Dooms includes M1 and Puddles leaves out (12.4,14.9), go to 3m north-west of the centre; when Dooms leaves out M1 and Puddles leaves out (12.4,14.9), go to 3m south-east of the centre.

RegenHealer.rule: When Dooms includes M2 and Puddles leaves out (-14.9,12.5), go to 4m west of the centre; when Dooms leaves out M2 and Puddles leaves out (-14.9,12.5), go to 4m south of the centre; when Dooms leaves out M2 and Puddles includes (-14.9,12.5), go to 4m west of the centre; when Dooms includes M2 and Puddles includes (-14.9,12.5), go to 3m north-east of the centre.

ShieldHealer.rule: When Dooms includes R2 and Puddles leaves out (-0,20), go to 3m north of the centre; when Dooms includes R2 and Puddles includes (-0,20), go to 4m south of the centre; when Dooms leaves out R2 and Puddles includes (-0,20), go to 3m north of the centre.

MeleeDpsA.rule: Depends on FirstDoomSquare and Puddles has (0,19.9): true & no → S 3m; false & yes → S 3m; false & no → N 4m.

PhysRangedDps.rule: When Puddles leaves out (0,19.9) and Puddles leaves out (14.9,12.5), go to 3m north-east of the centre; when Puddles includes (0,19.9) and Puddles includes (14.9,12.5), go to 3m north-east of the centre; when Puddles leaves out (0,19.9) and Puddles includes (14.9,12.5), go to 3m south-west of the centre.

CasterDps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: EyeBearing).

steps.title: After sprint on you
steps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: WarriorBearing).

RegenHealer.rule: with WarriorBearing as north: the west wall.

MeleeDpsB.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: EyeBearing).

PhysRangedDps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: EyeBearing).

ShieldHealer.rule: with WarriorBearing as north: the east wall.
